name: recall_v2
description: recall_v1 plus additional temporal-supersession pairs (q08, q13-q15). Each temporal query names the CURRENT fact as gold; an older superseded fact on the same subject is present as a recency distractor. Used to measure temporal-aware retrieval (Epoch X, slice 2).

memories.summary_text: The operator prefers dark mode in every interface.
memories.source_text: I always want dark mode on.

memories.summary_text: The operator's primary code editor is Neovim.
memories.source_text: I do all my editing in Neovim.

memories.summary_text: The operator wants concise answers and dislikes verbose explanations.
memories.source_text: Keep it short, I hate long-winded replies.

memories.summary_text: OMEGA-ARC runs entirely locally on Ollama.
memories.source_text: Everything runs local via Ollama, no cloud.

memories.summary_text: The deterministic runtime owns all state and persistence in OMEGA-ARC.
memories.source_text: State authority lives in the deterministic runtime.

memories.summary_text: The backend is a FastAPI application written in Python.
memories.source_text: Backend = FastAPI + Python.

memories.summary_text: The mobile operator consoles are built with SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
memories.source_text: iOS is SwiftUI, Android is Compose.

memories.summary_text: Bridge Zero is the desktop Mission Control and has no chat by design.
memories.source_text: Desktop Bridge Zero is read-only ops, no chat.

memories.summary_text: The operator's cat is named Pixel.
memories.source_text: My cat Pixel keeps sitting on the keyboard.

memories.summary_text: The operator is in the US Central time zone.
memories.source_text: I'm on Central time.

memories.summary_text: The default chat model is dolphin-mixtral, an uncensored model.
memories.source_text: Default model set to dolphin-mixtral.

memories.summary_text: The active chat model was switched to llama2-uncensored in the latest change.
memories.source_text: Switched the active model to llama2-uncensored.

memories.summary_text: The operator's favorite programming language is Rust.
memories.source_text: Rust is my favorite language by far.

memories.summary_text: Embeddings are produced by the local embeddinggemma model.
memories.source_text: We embed with embeddinggemma locally.

memories.summary_text: The operator drinks coffee black, no sugar.
memories.source_text: Black coffee, no sugar for me.

memories.summary_text: Operator approvals require on-device biometric confirmation such as Face ID or a fingerprint.
memories.source_text: Approvals need Face ID or fingerprint.

memories.summary_text: The release convention is patch-per-milestone within an epoch.
memories.source_text: Each milestone bumps the patch version.

memories.summary_text: The app icon spells 0M3-G4 in Aurebesh under a fisheye lens.
memories.source_text: Icon is 0M3-G4 in fisheye Aurebesh.

memories.summary_text: The backend originally listened on port 8000.
memories.source_text: Backend was on port 8000.

memories.summary_text: The backend now listens on port 8001.
memories.source_text: Backend moved to port 8001.

memories.summary_text: The operator used bash as their primary shell.
memories.source_text: I mostly use bash.

memories.summary_text: The operator switched to PowerShell as their primary shell.
memories.source_text: Moved over to PowerShell now.

memories.summary_text: OMEGA-ARC was at version 0.2.0 during the IX-B checkpoint.
memories.source_text: We were on 0.2.0 at the IX-B checkpoint.

memories.summary_text: OMEGA-ARC is now at version 0.2.1 after the IX-C release.
memories.source_text: Now on 0.2.1 after IX-C.
